equations.title: parity collision local factor
equations.assumptions: Formal series, or |x|<1; signed exponent-pair weights.

equations.title: Pell factorization
equations.assumptions: Exact quadratic-field identity; not an empirical fit.

equations.title: positive collision coefficient
equations.equation: A(p^k)=1 if k even, k+1 if k odd
equations.assumptions: Regroup signed pair series only in its absolute-convergence region Re(s)>1.

equations.title: ordinary cardinality descendant
equations.assumptions: An alternative positive population; individual signed terms remain signed.

equations.title: formal integer Euler exponents
equations.assumptions: Formal local identity; no assertion of convergence of an infinite zeta product in Re(s)>0.

equations.title: finite zeta extraction
equations.assumptions: Residual rational factor retained; sufficiently small primes may require separate factors.

equations.title: non-unit primitive numerator roots
equations.equation: N_L has roots inside and outside |x|=1 for every L>1
equations.assumptions: c0=1,c1=2,cD=zeta,c(D-1)=2*zeta^2 contradict self-inversiveness; primitive zeta, D=2L-2.

equations.title: integer Galois norm
equations.equation: P_L(x)=product_(a in units mod L)N_(L,zeta^a)(x) in Z[x]
equations.assumptions: Full prime-local Galois norm; differs from trace, character average and an individual complex product.

equations.title: all-conductor norm boundary
equations.equation: NormEuler_L has natural boundary Re(s)=0 iff L>1
equations.assumptions: Meromorphic continuation Re(s)>0 by classical Estermann; L1=zeta(s)^2. No individual-phase conclusion.

equations.title: local character projection
equations.assumptions: 1/L times all characters locally; Euler product imposes divisibility separately at each prime.

equations.title: projection degree and leading term
equations.equation: deg C_L=2L-min_(d|L)(d+L/d); leading=1 for square L,2 otherwise
equations.assumptions: Exact degree proof, not numerical root classification.

equations.title: projection gcd sum and derivative
equations.assumptions: All positive integer conductors; gcd(0,L)=L.

equations.title: exceptional projection classification
equations.equation: C_L has all unit-modulus roots iff L in {1,4}
equations.assumptions: Square-conductor reciprocity plus gcd-sum inequality; classical Estermann supplies analytic consequence.

equations.title: exceptional conductor four
equations.assumptions: Prime-local 4|v_p(m)v_p(n) for every p; differs from 4|kappa(m,n).

equations.title: two-term collision counting asymptotic
equations.assumptions: C=product_p(1-2/(p+1)^2); D=sum_p 4p*log(p)/((p+1)*(p^2+2p-1)); elementary convolution proof.

equations.title: certified leading constant
equations.assumptions: Finite exact prime product, integer P>=2; JSON rounding is outward. Not a finite-X asymptotic error bar.

equations.title: positive residue block populations
equations.assumptions: Actual exponent splits; count/rank/unrank at remote exponent without enumerating all splits.

equations.title: global residue factor-pair convolution
equations.equation: hist_(mn=N,kappa mod L)=cyclic_convolution_p hist_(a+b=v_p(N),ab mod L)
equations.assumptions: Supplied distinct primes verified within declared work budget; original integer outputs have separate bit guard.

equations.title: Pell unit binary transport
equations.assumptions: Exact or modular binary powering; remote modular values are not the complete integers.
